title: Settings — Parts alone can create, rename and delete a category
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role (made for this test) has 'Settings — Parts' but not 'See Financial Data'. An Admin makes the records below before the test.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click New Category.
  3. Type a name no other category uses.
  4. Click Create Category.
  5. Open Settings › Categories.
  6. Click category A's row.
  7. Click the category name at the top of the page.
  8. Type a new name no other category uses.
  9. Press Enter.
  10. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  11. Click Delete.
  12. Click Delete in the dialog.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories page shows.

Step 2:

  • The New Category page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name shows.

Step 4:

  • The category is created.

Step 5:

  • The Categories page lists category A.

Step 6:

  • Category A's page opens.

Step 7:

  • The name becomes editable.

Step 8:

  • The new name shows.

Step 9:

  • Category A is renamed.

Step 10:

  • The menu lists Delete.

Step 11:

  • The delete question opens.

Step 12:

  • Category A is deleted.
  • The Categories page shows without it.
